notes.title: I Walk Among Zombies Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you're doing well today. We have some good news to share with you! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/45cedfd34dc163b994248f927838305ca744e0fa.png[/img]
First up, I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 3 is coming to Steam this December! This time we will be offering a free 18+ DLC upgrade for the release instead of the game being adults only by default. This DLC on Steam is not available to users located in Japan due to their laws on uncensored content. We will also be offering the DLC on our website as well as a standalone adults only release of the game. Please wishlist the game on Steam and look forward to the release! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1131550/I_Walk_Among_Zombies_Vol_3/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1475320/I_Walk_Among_Zombies_Vol_3__18_Adult_Only_Content/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587075/8dc215bd6c6c97bf6ee0e4fc6f8cbc6be6149b89.png[/img]
And that's not all! I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 0 entered QA last week and it's going smoothly so far! Looks like it's wrapping up as well so it shouldn't be too much longer now. Maybe we'll see a store page go live soon? We'll just have to wait and see. We hope you enjoy the time you've spent with this series. Feel free to follow the newly created [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/39153917-I-Walk-Among-Zombies/]page for the series[/url] on Steam.

We'll have more surprises for you coming soon as well, so please do keep an eye out and keep following us for more!

Thanks for your patience, we're pleased to announce that I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 2 has now released on Steam! You can get the game uncensored and in English+Chinese language. To choose the language go to your steam library, right click "I Walk Among Zombies" or "末世孤雄" depending on your language preferences in Steam, click properties, then go to the language tab to pick the language you wish to download.
